item.title: reports: total per account and currency
item.brief: Operator request: our books now hold more than one currency. Implement the reports side of the shared contract in the contract text. Read CSV on stdin. Accept the new header with a currency column and also the old header without it (rows count as USD). Validate currency codes (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters); a malformed code prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Output header `account,currency,total_cents`, totals per account and currency, rows sorted by account then currency. Add python3 -m unittest tests covering: old CSV format counts as USD, new format totals per currency, sorting, malformed code exits 2 with a stderr message, and existing tests still pass. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate at the input boundary, and do not hide errors. Update the README. Commit in this repository only with the existing git identity, no attribution lines beyond the system instructions.

pr.summary: Made reports total per account and currency. Now reads the ledger's currency column; old headers count as USD. Malformed currency exits 2. Before: currency ignored, EUR and USD summed together (groceries,-5500). Now: groceries,EUR,-990 and groceries,USD,-4510.

risk.why: Output header changes from account,total_cents to account,currency,total_cents for every caller, which breaks downstream parsers of the old format. Scope is a small CLI and the change is in the README. Behaviour change for empty stdin is undocumented. Reviewer confirmed medium.

item.title: ledger: add per-row currency column
item.brief: Operator request: our books now hold more than one currency. Implement the ledger side of the shared contract in the contract text. Parse the optional fourth TSV column as an ISO 4217 code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; missing means USD). Emit header `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and a currency on every row. A malformed code prints an error naming the line number to stderr and exits with status 2; other input errors keep status 1. Add cargo tests covering: missing currency defaults to USD, valid explicit currency, malformed codes (lowercase, wrong length, digits, empty) exit 2 with line number, and existing behaviour still passes. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate at the input boundary, and do not hide errors. Update the README. Commit in this repository only with the existing git identity, no attribution lines beyond the system instructions.

state.summary:
ledger: per-row currency column implemented and committed on archon/tvg390b7-ledger-add-per-row-currency-column (head 975c51e, tree a85428b2452f196dd54a1f4ff0c8aafea460bb45; base bfd799f). Input: optional fourth TSV column, exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, missing means USD. Output header is now date,account,amount_cents,currency with a currency on every row. Malformed currency exits 2 with "line N:" on stderr; other input errors still exit 1. Before: header date,account,amount_cents, no currency, bad input exit 1. Checks on the head: cargo test 10/10 pass (2 original tests kept, 8 new unit and binary tests); cargo clippy --all-targets exit 0. cargo fmt --check reports diffs in new lines and one pre-existing line; the project does not enforce rustfmt, so I left formatting alone. Review: first reviewer returned FAIL on one blocking finding (padded codes like " EUR " were trimmed and accepted). Fixed in 6393969 -> 975c51e and covered by a test. Delta re-review of 6393969..975c51e passed with no blocking findings. Risk is raised to high (rubric: CLI and output changes that break callers), above the reviewers' medium. Open items: the reports side and README updates in the sibling repo are not part of this stage. Non-blocking notes: parse_line checks date and amount before currency, so a line with both a bad date and a bad currency exits 1. Entry gains a pub currency field and parse_line's error type changes from String to ParseError, which is a public API change. Nothing is left running: the reviewer processes have been stopped.

Missing fourth column defaults to USD. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs (exit code from the error), tests/ledger.rs (unit and binary tests), README.md. Checks: cargo test 10/10 pass; cargo clippy --all-targets exit 0. Review: one blocking finding (padded codes accepted) fixed in 975c51e with a test; delta re-review passed. Assumptions and limits: a line with both a bad date and a bad currency exits 1, because date and amount are checked first. Public API changes: Entry gains currency; parse_line's error type is now ParseError. The reports side is not in this change.
